senses.gloss: m. (preced.) great; great man; prince, officer.—Pl. רַבְרְבִין, רַבְרְבַיָּא, רַבְרְבֵי.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 8:18">Targ. II Sam. VIII, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
